title: FaultHypothesis
description: A single ranked fault candidate inside a DiagnosticCase. The model emits top-k; only k=3 surfaces by default in UI. Confidence is calibrated and disambiguated from source confidence and data quality.

rank.description: Position in the ranked top-k list. Rank 1 = most likely.

model_confidence_calibrated.description: Calibrated probability (Platt or isotonic), not raw model vote share.

model_confidence_raw.description: Raw model output for debug only; UI never shows this.

conformal_set.description: Conformal prediction set (e.g. all FMECA fault IDs covered at 95%). Empty until conformal pipeline is shipped.

source_confidence_tier.description: Citation strength of the FMECA row this hypothesis maps to. NOT model confidence.

fmeca_chain.description: Traversal of the KG path for evidence display.

comparable_cases.description: Historical case IDs whose feature signatures matched within configurable distance.

fmeca_priority_rank.description: Ordinal FMECA priority rank (S × O × D from sod_rpn.csv). NEVER use as monetary risk.

decision_route.description: Final routing decision from the confidence-tier × DQ × evidence-coverage matrix.
